findings: EMA psi=.7 faces have become more defined since step 500, and all 16 show clerical collars
Compared at the same 8 kimg with the paused control, some source hairstyle and apparent-age variation remains more visible
Ghosted eyes, mouths, glasses and face edges remain prominent; several faces share very similar structure
Raw and untruncated EMA grids still include severe facial distortions and malformed clothing/backgrounds
The small fixed-latent grids do not establish identity diversity or quality over unseen latents
decision: Do not promote. Continue the existing bounded 48-kimg CDC experiment and inspect the next checkpoints while the independent full-reference baseline runs. No claim of final convergence or proven superiority over the control.
